zh-CN.title: 桌面位置与浮层体验优化
items: 文件入口精简为云端资源和本地上传，位置可直接选择精确或模糊发送
足迹与语音浮层不再受聊天区域边界遮挡

en.title: Improved desktop location and popovers
items: Files now offer concise cloud and local actions, while locations can be sent precisely or approximately
Footprint and voice popovers are no longer clipped by the conversation boundary
